title: Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring models' agreement with pro-Russian versus pro-Ukrainian statements about the war in Ukraine, grouping responses by countries' official languages, and correlating the ideological balance with real-world geopolitical indicators like UN voting, foreign aid, and public opinion.

Prompting large language models with an identical set of 20 political statements translated into 112 different languages to evaluate how the language of the prompt alone alters the political perspective and assessment provided by the model.
